svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: GaiaKeep GFS: how the distributed system fits together
svg.desc: External AI agents send signed requests through the Cresco mesh to the replicated GaiaKeep core, which chunks, hashes, deduplicates and encrypts every block at the origin and erasure codes it across three sites whose durable tier is a tape library. Versions stream back out to agents, GPU pipelines and partners.

g.text: A global file system for AI agents: versioned datasets, durable on tape, streamed anywhere over the Cresco mesh
control plane: signed requests and events
dataplane: encrypted blocks on many flows
call the core's verbs as tools
Agents ask what a move costs, then ask for it
every block sealed at the origin
Erasure coded 2 + 1: any one site can be lost
